'''Wedge Antilles's T-65 X-wing''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] purchased for the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] after he resigned his commission to the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Navy]] to lead the former members of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] in liberating the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]] from [[Ysanne Isard]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==History==
{{Quote|Back when my parents operated a fuelling station at Gus Treta, my father was saving up to buy the station and start his own chain. The green, gold and black were going to be the colors he used for the logo.|Wedge Antilles explaining the meaning behind his X-wing's paintjob|<ref name="BW" />}}
In preparation for the AWOL Rogue Squadron's --now known as "[[Antilles's Rogues]]"-- guerrilla war against Isard's sect of the Empire, Wedge had a series of [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wings]] procured for his squadmates. To help distinguish their unit from the New Republic, it was recommended to Wedge by his second-in-command, [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]], that he individulize his X-wing by painting the hull of his X-wing with unique markings. Following Tycho's advice, Wedge painted the hull his X-wing [[Color/Legends|matte black]] with gold-and-green checkmarks along the front fuselage. The pattern was a tribute to the logo of the fuelling chain Wedge's father, [[Jagged Antilles]], once planned to start up.

Wedge piloted this X-wing through various skirmishes of what came to be known as the [[Bacta War]], culminating in the tumultuous [[Battle of Thyferra]], where he led his squadmates in a daring attack against the combined forces of Ysanne Isard's [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]], ''[[Lusankya/Legends|Lusankya]]'', and a massive detachment of [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE Interceptors]] piloted by the Isard-aligned [[Thyferran Home Defense Corps]]. Nearing the end of the battle, as the Antilles's Rogues lost their cruiser support, Wedge piloted his X-wing straight towards the incoming [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial-class Star Destroyer]], ''[[Errant Venture/Legends|Virulence]]'', hoping to go out in a blaze of glory. Yet before Wedge could commit his X-wing to this suicidal last stand, he discovered the ''Virulence'' had been commandeered by his ally [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Booster Terrik]] and was carrying a fighter screen of New Republic [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing Interceptors]]. With the A-wing reinforcements, Wedge piloted his X-wing to deal a crippling blow against the ''Lusankya'' and the THDC interceptors, bringing a victorious conclusion to the Battle of Thyferra.<ref name="BW" /> After the victory on Thyferra, Wedge once again piloted his X-wing over the cityscape of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for the entertainment of the New Republic citizenry celebrating the end of the Bacta War.<ref name="WS" />
